source:
@@U03154@@
(Snarling.)

@@U03155@@
I don’t like him!

@@U03157@@
(Snarling even worse.)

@@U03158@@
What does he want of us?

@@U03160@@
Nasty man!
He doesn’t belong here!

@@U03162@@
(Brutally)

@@U03163@@
Perhaps you think your visitor
is short on nails to tear with,
compared with your sharp claws?
Try me! We'll see!

@@U03165@@
(Gently)

@@U03166@@
You may stay. You'll soon be wanting
to leave by your own choice.
Where you come from,
you think you're somebody, but here,
if I’m not mistaken, you're ill at ease.

@@U03168@@
Your upper half is really quite appetizing;
it’s the down-below I find disgusting.

@@U03170@@
False creature, you'll pay for your rudeness!
Our claws are healthy, but you with your shriveled
horse’s hoof will find no pleasure in our company.

@@U03171@@
(塞壬们 are heard tuning up in the poplar trees.)

@@U03173@@
What are those birds in the poplar trees by the river?

@@U03175@@
Be on your guard! Their sing-song
has destroyed the very best of men.
translation:
@@U03154@@
（咆哮。）

@@U03155@@
我不喜欢他！

@@U03157@@
（咆哮得更厉害。）

@@U03158@@
他想从我们这里得到什么？

@@U03160@@
可恶的男人！
他不属于这里！

@@U03162@@
（残酷地）

@@U03163@@
也许您认为您的访客
指甲太短，无法撕扯，
与你锋利的爪子相比？
试试我吧！我们拭目以待吧！

@@U03165@@
（轻轻地）

@@U03166@@
你可以留下来。你很快就会想要
离开是你自己的选择。
你来自哪里，
你以为你是个人物，但在这里，
如果我没记错的话，你会感到不自在。

@@U03168@@
你的上半身真是太有食欲了；
我觉得恶心的是下面的地方。

@@U03170@@
虚伪的生物，你将为你的无礼付出代价！
我们的爪子还健康，而你却枯萎了
马蹄在我们的陪伴下不会感到快乐。

@@U03171@@
（可以听到塞壬人在白杨树上调音。）

@@U03173@@
河边杨树上的那些鸟是什么？

@@U03175@@
保持警惕！他们的歌声
毁掉了最优秀的人。
